definitions.explanation: A long, cylindrical yam (Dioscorea polystachya) widely used in Japanese cooking. When grated, it produces a sticky, slimy paste called とろろ, which is eaten over rice or in soups. One of the most common varieties of Japanese yam available in supermarkets.

{長芋|ながいも}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。

{長芋|ながいも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{短冊切|たんざくぎ}り→短冊切り：08087_tanzakugiri⟧にして⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like cutting nagaimo into strips and eating it with soy sauce and seaweed.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ ('long') and ⟦{芋|いも}→芋：10231_imo⟧ ('yam; potato'). Named for its long, straight shape, which distinguishes it from other varieties of Japanese yam. {長芋|ながいも} is the most readily available and affordable variety of ⟦{山芋|やまいも}→山芋：22494_yamaimo⟧ (mountain yam) in Japanese supermarkets and is a staple ingredient in home cooking.

USAGE:
- When grated, {長芋|ながいも} produces a sticky, mucilaginous paste called とろろ, which is poured over hot rice ({とろろご飯|とろろごはん}) or into soups.
- Can also be sliced into strips (⟦{短冊切|たんざくぎ}り→短冊切り：08087_tanzakugiri⟧) for salads, or cut into rounds and pan-fried.
- Handling raw {長芋|ながいも} can cause itching on the skin due to needle-like calcium oxalate crystals — a commonly shared kitchen tip.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長芋|ながいも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すりおろす: to grate nagaimo
- {長芋|ながいも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{短冊切|たんざくぎ}り→短冊切り：08087_tanzakugiri⟧: nagaimo cut into strips
- {長芋|ながいも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とろろ: grated nagaimo paste
- {長芋|ながいも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{浅漬|あさづ}け→浅漬け：13308_asazuke⟧: lightly pickled nagaimo

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{山芋|やまいも}→山芋：22494_yamaimo⟧: mountain yam — the general category of Japanese yams, of which {長芋|ながいも} is one variety
- ⟦{自然薯|じねんじょ}→自然薯：24130_jinenjo⟧: wild yam — a wild variety that grows naturally in mountainous areas; considered a delicacy with a stronger flavor and stickier texture
- {大和芋|やまといも}: Yamato yam — a flat or hand-shaped variety with a denser, stickier texture than {長芋|ながいも}
